comparison.objective: Hand-tighten a threaded oil filter through gasket contact to a prescribed angular range; candidate registers and secures two sensor endpoints.
comparison.physical_skill: Repeated cylindrical regrasp-and-twist versus partial screw release, precision sliding, holding, and retightening.
comparison.success_condition: Filter must finish 240–360° past contact without removal/over-tightening; candidate needs two ≤6 mm, over-center registrations retained 3 s.
comparison.reason: Only generic fastening is shared. Candidate still lacks exact mount/screw geometry, torque, indicator hysteresis, and a numeric post-tightening drift tolerance.
